notes: v598 — ONE STORE FOR ALL GRADED WINDOWS. The real defect behind v597 wasn't a missing check — it was that ‘the graded answer’ lived in up to THREE separate places (the radar's own background warm, the report card's fast path, and the card's other-window cache), kept in sync only by matching invalidation logic scattered through the file. That's the exact kind of thing that silently drifts as features get added — which is what happened. Tonight that's removed at the root: every window (5d, 10d, 30d) now writes into ONE keyed store, and whichever window is currently selected mirrors automatically to what the radar reads. Two independent server calls for the same window now also collapse into one — if the card already fetched a window, the radar finds it already cached instead of asking again. The deep-dive audit harness now also checks this kind of provenance bug, not just whether screens agree on data they're given. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
